title: Noise stability of odd-dimensional majority
statement: For any correlation parameter $\rho\in[-1,1]$, the noise stability of majority on $2k+1$ sign coordinates, evaluated on two uniformly distributed sign vectors coupled with coordinate correlation $\rho$, tends as $k\to\infty$ to $1-(2/\pi)\arccos(\rho)$.
